newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil eases.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil eases.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was soft on Thursday and buying interest was thin, traders said.

Dealers assessed prices for Klaipeda E-4 material, which currently contains around 1.7 percent water, at around the mean/mean/mean of published quotes, while better quality material from Ventspils was assessed at around a dollar over this level.
Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was little changed and offers were pegged at around $120 cif.
